_comment: Example of the host config these wrappers read: copy to ~/.config/crush/crush.json and edit. wrapCodex.sh/wrapCrush.sh only use providers whose type is openai-compat, and wrapCodex.sh asks each base_url's /models for what is actually being served, so 'models' is only a fallback for when a server is down. api_key may be a literal key or the name of an environment variable ('$VLLM_API_KEY' or '${VLLM_API_KEY}'), which keeps real keys out of this file.
